clue.text: Boring collection of notes

parts.note: TI is a note of the tonic sol-fa scale
RE is a note of the tonic sol-fa scale
SO is a note of the tonic sol-fa scale
ME (or MI) is a note of the tonic sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A dull assortment of musical notes, or of written memos, fails to hold interest.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'collection' is four notes of the sol-fa scale (do, re, mi, fa, so, la, ti) strung together.
explanation.definitionFit: Something tedious that wearies you is dull, uninteresting.

clue.text: Discover about new form of ecstasy

indicators.note: the first word's synonym goes about, that is surrounds, the abbreviation that follows

parts.note: to discover is to trace, track down

explanation.surface: Someone finds out about a new kind of the drug ecstasy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ecstasy' suggests the drug, but here it is a state of rapture.
explanation.definitionFit: A dazed, rapt state of mind is a kind of ecstasy, rapture.

clue.text: Make good theatre available across half of county

indicators.note: the theatre word lies across, spanning, the half-word that follows

parts.note: REP is short for repertory theatre

indicators.note: only the first half of the word county is taken

explanation.surface: A theatre company does well by touring part of a county.
explanation.walkthrough: Half of COUNTY is COU, which REP spans to give RE-COU-P.
explanation.definitionFit: To recover a loss is to make it good, regain what was spent.

clue.text: Peas and chips cooked together in vessel — out of this world!

indicators.note: cooking the two foods together mixes them up, so their letters are rearranged as one pool

explanation.surface: A recipe: peas and chips cooked together in one pan.
explanation.walkthrough: The nine letters of PEAS and CHIPS are rearranged; 'and' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A craft that travels beyond Earth is a vessel out of this world, literally.

clue.text: Failed to understand how girl, so to speak, got pregnant

indicators.note: so to speak signals that the word for a girl is taken as it sounds when spoken, not as spelt

parts.note: a miss is a girl or young woman
to conceive is to become pregnant

explanation.surface: A tale of how a young woman came to be expecting.
explanation.walkthrough: MISS said aloud gives MIS, which joins CONCEIVED; 'how' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To grasp something wrongly is to have a mistaken notion of it.

clue.text: Missile to face Chinese craft

parts.note: SAM is a surface-to-air missile
pan is slang for the face

explanation.surface: A missile is set against a Chinese boat.
explanation.definitionFit: A small flat-bottomed boat of the Far East is a Chinese vessel.

clue.text: Came to give permission in fear

indicators.note: the permission word is placed in the fear word

parts.note: awe is reverential fear
to OK is to approve, give permission

explanation.surface: Someone allowed something while frightened.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Came to' looks like arrival, but it means regained consciousness.
explanation.definitionFit: To come to is to regain consciousness, rouse from sleep.

clue.text: Alternative for plait on youth's head?

definitions.text: Alternative for plait on youth's head?

parts.words: Alternative for plait on youth's head?
parts.note: a hairstyle gathered at the back of a young person's head, a choice instead of braiding, named after a young horse's tail

explanation.surface: A hairdressing option for a young person instead of a braid.
explanation.walkthrough: 'youth' hints at a young horse, a pony, whose tail names the style.
explanation.definitionFit: A bunch of hair tied at the back of the head is a common style besides a braid.

clue.text: State breaks out in an uprising

indicators.note: the jumbled word goes in the reversed short word
in a down clue an uprising reads the word an from bottom to top
out means the letters of breaks are set out of order

explanation.surface: A state rebellion erupts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uprising' suits a down clue, where the short word reads upward; 'out' scrambles the breaking word, and the rebellion picture hides a plain US state.
explanation.definitionFit: A Midwestern US state.

clue.text: The old-fashioned term "charisma" needs changing

indicators.note: the word charisma has to be altered, its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A complaint that the word charisma has gone out of date and wants replacing.
explanation.definitionFit: A word or expression that has passed out of use is an antiquated term.

clue.text: Mix socially with aristocrat that's on the shelf

indicators.note: the aristocrat word sits on, comes after, the shelf word

parts.note: a hob is a shelf beside a fireplace for keeping things warm
nob is British slang for a wealthy or upper-class person

explanation.surface: A peer left on the shelf goes out to mingle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the shelf' suggests being left unmarried, but here it is the fireside shelf, and 'that's on' places the aristocrat after it. The aristocrat word is British slang for a posh person.
explanation.definitionFit: To rub shoulders with people is to mingle with them socially.

clue.text: One who renders the raw material for soap

definitions.text: One who renders the raw material for soap

parts.words: One who renders the raw material for soap
parts.note: reads like someone melting down fat to make soap, but it is the writer who supplies the words for a television soap opera

explanation.surface: A tallow-renderer boiling down fat for soapmaking.
explanation.walkthrough: To 'render' fat is to melt it down for soap; the second sense is producing the text for a soap opera.
explanation.definitionFit: A writer of television drama produces the words for a soap opera.

clue.text: Ill-mannered whether head is present or not

parts.words: whether head is present or not
parts.note: with its first letter the word means vulgar, and without that first letter it still means impolite, so either way it fits the definition

explanation.surface: Being impolite whether or not the headteacher is around.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove the first letter and RUDE is left, which also means ill-mannered.
explanation.definitionFit: Coarse, vulgar behaviour lacks manners.

clue.text: Its leader takes a bow

parts.note: suggests a performer bowing to applause, but the leader of a symphonic ensemble is its principal violinist, who plays with a bow

explanation.surface: A star acknowledges the applause at curtain call.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain the 'leader' is the first violinist, not the conductor.
explanation.definitionFit: A large ensemble of musicians is led by its first violinist.

clue.text: Key man in hair of vivid hue

indicators.note: the key man is placed in the hair word

parts.note: a shock is a thick mass of hair
a kingpin is the most important person in a group

explanation.surface: A leading figure sporting brightly dyed hair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Key' tempts toward a piano or lock; with 'man' it means the most important person, and 'in' tucks him into the thick mop of hair.
explanation.definitionFit: A brilliant magenta colour is a vivid shade.

clue.text: Has he travelled right round Lido? Possibly

definitions.text: Has he travelled right round Lido? Possibly

indicators.note: the travelled word goes round the rearranged resort name

parts.note: having travelled is having gone

indicators.note: possibly means the letters of Lido may be rearranged

explanation.surface: Wondering whether a Venetian boatman has rowed all the way round the Lido.
explanation.walkthrough: The Lido is a beach island at Venice. 'Possibly' rearranges its name and 'round' wraps the travelled word about it, before the right abbreviation ends the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A Venetian boatman might well row round the Lido island off Venice.

clue.text: Wife was sick and miserable

parts.note: retched means vomited, was sick

explanation.surface: A woman who was ill and unhappy.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone in a pitiful, unhappy state is wretched, miserable.

clue.text: Such very important points seen in news

definitions.text: Such very important points seen in news

parts.words: Such very important points seen in news
parts.note: the four compass points north, east, west and south are the initials making up the word news, and the adjective for those principal points also means very important

explanation.surface: Key stories reported in the press.
explanation.walkthrough: N, E, W and S, the letters of NEWS, are the four principal compass points.
explanation.definitionFit: The principal compass points carry this name, which also means of chief importance.

clue.text: Choosing the same person again to collect cement

parts.note: to reap is to gather in, collect
pointing is the mortar filling the joints of brickwork

explanation.surface: Selecting someone again to gather up mortar.
explanation.definitionFit: Naming someone to a post again is selecting the same individual once more.

clue.text: A number of horses making way to arena

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way
a ring is an arena, as in a boxing or circus ring

explanation.surface: Horses making their way into the ring.
explanation.definitionFit: The racehorses kept by one owner or stable form a group.

clue.text: On foot, hunt for black bird

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
an eagle is a bird of prey

explanation.surface: Hunting a black bird on foot.
explanation.definitionFit: To go hunting hares on foot with small hounds is a sport named after the dog breed.

clue.text: Derby date arranged for Flyte's animal Aloysius

indicators.note: the letters of Derby and date are arranged into a new order

explanation.surface: A racing fixture set for an aristocrat's pet.
explanation.walkthrough: Sebastian Flyte in Evelyn Waugh's Brideshead Revisited carries a toy bear named Aloysius.
explanation.definitionFit: Aloysius is the stuffed toy bear carried by Sebastian Flyte in Brideshead Revisited.

clue.text: What, after start of year, old antelope raised?

definitions.text: What, after start of year, old antelope raised?

indicators.note: the start of the word year is its first letter
in a down clue raised reads the antelope word from bottom to top

parts.note: a gnu is an African antelope, the wildebeest

explanation.surface: A question about what an old antelope reared after the new year began.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns the antelope upward in this down clue. The whole clue also defines: offspring are what an antelope raised.
explanation.definitionFit: Offspring are what an animal rears.

clue.text: Not within respectable limits?

parts.note: out means not inside, not within

indicators.note: the limits of respectable are its first and last letters

explanation.surface: Asking whether something has strayed beyond what is decent.
explanation.walkthrough: OUT plus R and E, the first and last letters of 'respectable'. The whole clue also defines.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unconventional or bizarre lies beyond the bounds of propriety.

clue.text: Inhibition, getting ring off

definitions.meaning: to end a phone call by replacing the receiver

explanation.definitionFit: A neurotic block is an emotional problem, and ending a phone call replaces the receiver.

clue.text: Hitting out

definitions.meaning: out means on strike, refusing to work

explanation.definitionFit: Delivering a blow is beating, and workers out are stopping work in protest.

clue.text: Drag into the river and drown

indicators.note: the drag word is put into the river word

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Britain
to lug is to drag, haul

explanation.surface: Hauling someone into the river to drown them.
explanation.walkthrough: The Dee is a river in Scotland and in Wales. 'drown' is a verb: to flood or swamp.
explanation.definitionFit: To flood or overwhelm is to inundate, swamp.

clue.text: Discontinue session with publicity agent, a scoundrel

parts.note: PRO is a public relations officer
a rogue is a scoundrel

explanation.surface: Parliament is suspended because of a crooked spin doctor.
explanation.definitionFit: To end a parliamentary sitting without dissolving it is to suspend the session.
